records.process_description: Eligibility: you must have relevant prior knowledge in the subject area (relevant lectures attended and passed); some provided topics list additional requirements. How to find and approach a supervisor: use the Business Theses Market—either upload your own Research Proposal (2–3 pages) assigned to the correct research area, or apply for a posted topic (requires a short letter of motivation). Professor links on the department page lead to chair websites. Registration and documents: digital application via the Business Theses Market with CV, transcript of records (current export) and Research Proposal for own topics; you need your UZH login. After a successful match you are contacted by the supervisor and collect the official thesis assignment on OLAT. Key formal points and deadlines: collecting the OLAT assignment starts the six‑month writing period; matching typically takes up to two months (no feedback after two months = proposal rejected); submit your thesis via OLAT as a ZIP file; you receive a grade within one month. Official guidelines: follow the Dean’s Office rules and the department’s “Possible Topic Areas” document; contact theses@business.uzh.ch for questions.
